en: {player}! Over here! You passed Lana's trial too? Awesome!
Alola, cousin! This is the Battle Royal Dome. Four trainers in one ring, each against the rest. It gets loud, yeah!
It's not open to newcomers yet. So how about a regular battle out here instead, the two of you?
Yes! I've been training the whole way from Paniola. Let's go!
Aw, man! Your Pokémon are on fire today. I'm getting a malasada to recover.
I won! I won! Okay, I'm still getting a malasada.
Woo! That's what I like to see. Kiawe's trial is on Wela Volcano Park: Route 8 north, then Route 7's beach.
Isn't the dome something? One day you'll stand in that ring, cousin. I can feel it!
Royal Avenue's got everything! Shops, a dome, and a malasada stand somewhere. I just have to find it.
